_comment: Party progression (issue #15). levels: XP to go from level L to L+1 is round(xp_base * xp_growth^(L-1)), up to max (tuned with tools/balance_sim.gd, issue #35: the Auditor around level 6 to 8, level 20 left for the last chapters). growth: what each level adds per field hero (hp, damage, ink; fractions add up and round down, so 0.5 damage = +1 every other level). Base stats live in data/heroes.json. items: gear. slot: weapon, armor or trinket (consumables are the quick menu's satchel, issue #6). hero: weapon belongs to that hero only. stats: added to the hero (hp, damage, power_rate = gauge refill bonus as a fraction, speed px/s, reach px, guard = fraction of damage blocked, ink, heal = poultice HP). price: Gilt in the Hollowmark shop (sells back for half). shop: false = only found on missions. needs: research node that must be known before the shop stocks it. drops: per-kill chance on missions and the weighted table picked from; items found are kept on success or retreat and lost if the party is wiped out. barracks_xp: XP a day for each field hero on the bench (not in the party), per Barracks level. mission_xp: bonus XP to the party for finishing a mission (missions.json can set its own "xp"). skills (issue #24): weapon skill per field hero, level 1 to max, raised by using the signature weapon; weapon_xp[L-1] = points from level L to L+1. A landed full-power swing gives swing points, a landed swing at half power or more light_swing, a tech that lands tech. Each level teaches the next charged tech (data/techs.json). barracks: weapon points a day per Barracks level for each benched field hero, who can only drill up to barracks_cap (the last techs come from real fights). Ink colour skills live in data/abilities.json (ink_skill).

quill_knife.name: Quill-knife
quill_knife.blurb: A pen sharpened past the point of writing. Ash woke up holding it.

steel_nib.name: Steel Nib
steel_nib.blurb: A longer, meaner nib. Signs things permanently.

ravens_quill.name: Crow Quill
ravens_quill.blurb: Black, glossy and impatient. It wants the next stroke before you finish this one.

vespers_nib.name: Vespers Nib
vespers_nib.blurb: A silver nib from the Abbey's copying desks, blessed for writing scripture. Ash uses it for punctuation.

inkpearl_quill.name: Inkpearl Quill
inkpearl_quill.blurb: A black pearl set in the barrel, still muttering the lake's unfinished word. Every stroke finishes it for someone.

the_last_word.name: The Last Word
the_last_word.blurb: Gold leaf, ledger steel and a nib cut from frozen sea. It writes one thing, and nobody argues with it.

contract_cleaver.name: Contract Cleaver
contract_cleaver.blurb: Bran's old cleaver. The handle has his rates carved into it.

notary_axe.name: Notary's Axe
notary_axe.blurb: Used to stamp seals into wax. Now stamps them into Nibblers.

foreclosure.name: Foreclosure
foreclosure.blurb: A two-handed cleaver the size of a door. Bran calls it a negotiating position.

abbots_headsman.name: Abbot's Headsman
abbots_headsman.blurb: The Abbey kept an executioner's axe for heretics. Bran says the heretics were underpaid.

velvet_guillotine.name: Velvet Guillotine
velvet_guillotine.blurb: A masquerade stage prop that turned out to be load-bearing. The velvet wraps the grip, and nothing else about it is soft.

final_notice.name: Final Notice
final_notice.blurb: A cleaver forged from the Ledger's own shelving. Bran had his rates engraved on it again, in larger type.

bone_ladle.name: Bone Ladle
bone_ladle.blurb: Gristle won't say whose bone. She will say it stirs well.

copper_ladle.name: Copper Ladle
copper_ladle.blurb: Conducts heat, gossip and, apparently, healing.

cauldron_spoon.name: Cauldron Spoon
cauldron_spoon.blurb: Long enough to stir a soup from across the room. Or to reach a patient who is running away.

censer_ladle.name: Censer Ladle
censer_ladle.blurb: Swung on a chain in the Abbey, trailing holy smoke. Gristle fills it with broth and swings it at people.

banquet_spoon.name: Banquet Spoon
banquet_spoon.blurb: Pinched from the masquerade's high table. Pearl handle, silver bowl, and a dent that matches a duke.

ladle_of_last_rites.name: Ladle of Last Rites
ladle_of_last_rites.blurb: Gristle stirred the capital's gold into it herself. Whatever it serves, you get up again.

concord_pike.name: Concord Pike
concord_pike.blurb: Standard Concord issue. Daro filed off the serial number and one of the prongs.

tollkeeper_pike.name: Tollkeeper's Pike
tollkeeper_pike.blurb: Made for blocking bridges. Long, heavy, and very persuasive.

breach_lance.name: Breach Lance
breach_lance.blurb: A siege lance cut down to something one reckless person can carry.

belltower_halberd.name: Bell-tower Halberd
belltower_halberd.blurb: Hung by the Abbey's bell ropes to keep thieves off them. Daro is a thief, and now so is the halberd.

causeway_glaive.name: Causeway Glaive
causeway_glaive.blurb: A bridge-warden's glaive, light as a cane and longer than a gondola. Collects tolls at a distance.

spire_breaker.name: Spire-breaker
spire_breaker.blurb: Built to pull down a tower. Daro has not found the right tower yet, and is looking.

brass_knuckles.name: Brass Knuckles
brass_knuckles.blurb: Engraved KEEP and OUT. She has never needed the second one.

door_knocker.name: Door Knocker
door_knocker.blurb: Twisted off the cabaret's front door the night the magistrate left through it.

bouncers_gauntlets.name: Bouncer's Gauntlets
bouncers_gauntlets.blurb: Riveted iron up to the elbow. Nobody argues with the guest list any more.

bellclapper_fists.name: Bell-clapper Fists
bellclapper_fists.blurb: Two clappers out of a cracked abbey bell, riveted into knuckles. Every punch rings, and the ringing lasts.

last_warning.name: Last Warning
last_warning.blurb: Velvet-wrapped iron from the Causeway's doormen. The first warning is the velvet. There is no second one.

closing_time.name: Closing Time
closing_time.blurb: Gauntlets plated in the capital's gold. When she raises them the party is over, and everybody knows it.

hook_knives.name: Hook-knives
hook_knives.blurb: Cargo hooks filed into blades. Good for crates, ropes and people who ask about crates.

moonless_pair.name: Moonless Pair
moonless_pair.blurb: Blackened so they don't catch the light. Neither does she.

tide_and_tithe.name: Tide and Tithe
tide_and_tithe.blurb: One knife for the customs man, one for whoever sent him.

vigil_knives.name: Vigil Knives
vigil_knives.blurb: Silver candle-snuffers from the Abbey, ground to an edge. They put out lights, and other things.

pearl_divers_pair.name: Pearl-diver's Pair
pearl_divers_pair.blurb: Short black blades from the ink lake's divers. Made to cut a pearl free before your breath runs out.

nothing_declared.name: Nothing Declared
nothing_declared.blurb: Saltglass knives no customs house has ever found. She walked them through the Spire's gate twice to be sure.

iron_ledger.name: Iron-bound Ledger
iron_ledger.blurb: The Concord's own tithe book. Every page she took it with is a debt they still owe.

assessors_seal.name: Assessor's Seal
assessors_seal.blurb: A brass seal on a chain. Leaves APPROVED on wax and on foreheads.

book_of_arrears.name: Book of Arrears
book_of_arrears.blurb: Lists everything everyone owes. It's heavier than it should be, and it's still getting heavier.

penitents_tally.name: Penitent's Tally
penitents_tally.blurb: The Abbey's ledger of sins, iron-bound and chained to her wrist. Every name in it is overdue.

masquerade_register.name: Masquerade Register
masquerade_register.blurb: Lists who came to the masquerade, who they came as, and who they really were. Heavier every night.

index_of_the_ledger.name: Index of the Great Ledger
index_of_the_ledger.blurb: The index to the Great Ledger itself. She doesn't need the Ledger now. She knows where everything is.

stage_rapier.name: Stage Rapier
stage_rapier.blurb: Blunted for the cabaret. She had it sharpened again the night the Blank came to the door.

courtiers_smallsword.name: Courtier's Smallsword
courtiers_smallsword.blurb: Light enough to dance with. She has, and the partner did not enjoy it.

crimson_encore.name: Crimson Encore
crimson_encore.blurb: Named for the bow she takes after every duel. There has never been a second act.

matins_foil.name: Matins Foil
matins_foil.blurb: An abbey fencing master's foil, silver-chased. He taught it to pray. She taught it to bow.

masked_ball.name: Masked Ball
masked_ball.blurb: A Causeway rapier with a pearl in the guard. Nobody at the masquerade saw her draw it, which was the point.

standing_ovation.name: Standing Ovation
standing_ovation.blurb: Ledger steel, gold leaf, a saltglass edge. The last duel she fights with it gets the whole house on its feet.

padded_coat.name: Padded Coat
padded_coat.blurb: Quilted, patched and warm. Smells faintly of someone else's dog.

ledger_mail.name: Ledger Mail
ledger_mail.blurb: Rings of iron threaded with old ledger pages. Teeth catch on the sums.

inkskin_vest.name: Inkskin Vest
inkskin_vest.blurb: A vest of written leather. The words knit shut where something bites.

mothsilk_shawl.name: Mothsilk Shawl
mothsilk_shawl.blurb: Light as a rumour and nearly as hard to pin down. The words in the silk rearrange themselves into compliments.

tollkeepers_coat.name: Tollkeeper's Coat
tollkeepers_coat.blurb: Heavy oilcloth sewn with toll-tokens. It has turned aside knives, rain and three separate bribes.

chapel_hauberk.name: Chapel Hauberk
chapel_hauberk.blurb: Silver-washed mail from the Abbey's armoury. Blank things that bite it come away looking unwell.

penitents_cassock.name: Penitent's Cassock
penitents_cassock.blurb: Black wool with a bell sewn at every hem. It rings when you are about to do something you will regret.

masquers_brigandine.name: Masquer's Brigandine
masquers_brigandine.blurb: Steel plates hidden under velvet. At the masquerade it passed for a costume, right up until the stabbing.

pearlscale_coat.name: Pearlscale Coat
pearlscale_coat.blurb: Scales of black pearl shell over silk. The lake's half-said words hum in it when the Ink runs.

ledgerplate.name: Ledgerplate
ledgerplate.blurb: Armour forged from the Great Ledger's shelving and gilded like a clerk's dream. Signed for, in triplicate.

saltglass_mantle.name: Saltglass Mantle
saltglass_mantle.blurb: A cloak of frozen sea on a wreck-oak frame. Blows slide off it the way ships slid into the white.

bent_nib.name: Bent Nib
bent_nib.blurb: A pen nib bent into a ring. Pointy on the inside too, so you stay alert.

lucky_button.name: Lucky Button
lucky_button.blurb: Off a coat that survived the Blank. The coat's owner did not, which raises questions.

running_boots.name: Courier's Laces
running_boots.blurb: Laces from a courier's boots. Your feet get the idea.

blotter_charm.name: Blotter Charm
blotter_charm.blurb: A square of blotting paper in a locket. Soaks up spilt Ink for later.

wormwood_sachet.name: Wormwood Sachet
wormwood_sachet.blurb: A pouch of wormwood worn under the collar. Poison takes one sniff and leaves.

smiths_patch.name: Smith's Apron Patch
smiths_patch.blurb: A square of scorched leather from a smith's apron, sewn over the heart. Nothing catches.

leech_locket.name: Leech Locket
leech_locket.blurb: A locket with a dried leech inside. Every hit you land, it drinks a little and passes it on.

gamblers_die.name: Gambler's Die
gamblers_die.blurb: Six sides, all of them sixes. Your first hit on anything lands like you meant it.

inkblot_brooch.name: Inkblot Brooch
inkblot_brooch.blurb: A brooch of black glass. When something dies nearby it soaks up what spills: 4 Ink a kill.

gilt_tooth.name: Gilt Tooth
gilt_tooth.blurb: A gold tooth on a cord, owner unknown. Every enemy that falls nearby coughs up a coin.

thornwire_bracelet.name: Thornwire Bracelet
thornwire_bracelet.blurb: Barbed wire twisted into a bracelet. Whatever hits you up close gets 6 damage back for its trouble.

widows_ribbon.name: Widow's Ribbon
widows_ribbon.blurb: Black silk tied round the wrist. Below a third of your HP you hit 40% harder and take less. Grief is a weapon.

steady_bell.name: Steady Bell
steady_bell.blurb: A thumb-sized abbey bell. While it rings in your ear, nothing knocks the sense out of you.

bellringers_clapper.name: Bellringer's Clapper
bellringers_clapper.blurb: A bronze clapper on a thong. Full-power swings ring like a bell, and whatever they hit stands dazed.

clockwork_heart.name: Clockwork Heart
clockwork_heart.blurb: Brass and pearl, ticking under the shirt. Charged techs wind up a quarter faster.

saltglass_eye.name: Saltglass Eye
saltglass_eye.blurb: A glass eye made of frozen sea. It remembers everything, so the Blank can't make you forget.

second_signature.name: Second Signature
second_signature.blurb: A gilt-edged card with your name on it, twice. Once a mission, the first time you fall, you get back up.

shop_blurb: Odds, ends and sharp things, sold off a cart that is never in the same place twice.
